content.text: Drafting the explanation from the engine's scenarios.

result: For your projection of 1 571 000 Kč income and 383 200 Kč actual expenses: the 60 % flat rate counts 942 600 Kč of expenses, and tax and insurance come to 197 584 Kč whether you buy the laptop this year or next, because under the flat rate the purchase doesn't change the tax base. With actual expenses and the laptop bought this year the total is 379 116 Kč; buying it next year instead adds 21 810 Kč. Against that baseline the flat rate is 181 532 Kč lower, but your social insurance assessment base, from which your pension is later worked out, is 249 700 Kč lower too. Paušální daň isn't assessed because the rule pack doesn't hold the 2026 bands yet. A scenario for your review, not tax advice.

levers: Expenses: actual or the 60 % flat rate
Laptop: bought this year or next
